description: This file defines database migration classes for Room, an Android persistence library. It specifies schema changes such as renaming columns and deleting tables, each implementing AutoMigrationSpec to facilitate automated database schema migrations between versions.

classes.name: Schema2to3
classes.description: Defines a migration from schema version 2 to 3, renaming the 'description' column to 'shortDescription' in the 'topics' table.

classes.name: Schema10to11
classes.description: Defines a migration from schema version 10 to 11, deleting the 'episode_id' column from 'news_resources' and removing the 'episodes_authors' and 'episodes' tables.

classes.name: Schema11to12
classes.description: Defines a migration from schema version 11 to 12, removing the 'news_resources_authors' and 'authors' tables.
